facts.fact: The Rwanda AI Agency's World Bank GFPP grant (E6900-001) is to finance GPU compute equipment with co-location, hosting and maintenance, and consulting for foundational AI-ready data assets and registries, to support piloting of AI use cases in priority sectors (plan dated October 2026).
facts.system: GFPP-financed GPU compute and foundational data assets

systems.platform: GPU compute with co-location and cloud and AI model services
